posts.name: pppery
posts.cooked:
Edwin:

New environment deck:  The TARDIS.  Consists of five copies of Fixed Point and ten Rift in Times.

 

PROBLEM DETECTED:

This environment deck has the capability to (and is quite likely to) put the game into an unescapable deadlock. For example:

Environment turn 1:

Start: Nothing happens

Play: rift in time(1)

End:rift in time(1) plays rift in time(2)

      rift in time(2) plays fixed point(1).

In play:rift in time(1), rift in time(2), fixed point(1)

Environment turn 2:

Start: rift in time(1) destroys rift in time (2)

         fixed point(1) destroys itself

Play: fixed point(2)

End: rift in time(1) plays fixed point(3).

In play:rift in time(1), fixed point(2), fixed point(3),

From this point on, the game can never end because all cards are indestructable including the fixed points, which make eachother indestructable
